agent_types.CoordinatorAgent: Responsible for overseeing the interactions between agents and ensuring the system's objectives are met.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Facilitates information exchange between agents, ensuring messages are delivered accurately and efficiently.
agent_types.DecisionAgent: Analyzes data and makes decisions to guide the system towards its goals, often using algorithms or heuristics.
agent_types.EnvironmentAgent: Simulates the external environment, providing data and feedback to other agents to inform their actions.
agent_types.MonitoringAgent: Tracks the performance and status of the system, alerting other agents to any issues or anomalies.
